text: Amends the Safe Drinking Water Act to increase funding for emerging contaminants remediation from $100 million to $1 billion annually for fiscal years 2027-2031, and establishes a new Federal Water Pollution Control Act program providing $1 billion annually through 2031 for grants addressing emerging contaminants, particularly perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances, with at least 25 percent directed to small and disadvantaged communities.
